auth.verify_email.title: Confirm your email address
auth.verify_email.subject: Jappo — confirm your email address
auth.verify_email.body:
Hello {{fullName}},

Welcome to Jappo. Confirm your email address by opening this link:
{{link}}

This link expires in 48 hours.

auth.password_reset.title: Password reset
auth.password_reset.subject: Jappo — reset your password
auth.password_reset.body:
Hello {{fullName}},

To choose a new password, open this link:
{{link}}

This link expires in 1 hour. If you did not request this, ignore this message.

auth.otp.title: Login code
auth.otp.sms: Jappo: your code is {{code}}. It expires in 5 minutes. Do not share it.

member.invited.title: Invitation to join {{orgName}}
member.invited.subject: Jappo — invitation to join {{orgName}}
member.invited.body:
Hello,

{{inviterName}} invites you to join {{orgName}} on Jappo (roles: {{roles}}).
Accept the invitation: {{link}}

This link expires in 7 days.

org.kyc_submitted.title: KYC submitted: {{orgName}}
org.kyc_submitted.subject: Jappo — KYC to review: {{orgName}}
org.kyc_submitted.body: {{orgName}} has submitted its KYC documents. Review them in the admin console: {{link}}

org.kyc_verified.title: Your organisation is verified
org.kyc_verified.subject: Jappo — {{orgName}} is verified
org.kyc_verified.body: Good news: the KYC verification of {{orgName}} is approved. All features are now available.
